signature: SUBROUTINE DTREXC( COMPQ, N, T, LDT, Q, LDQ, IFST, ILST, WORK,

params.name: compq
params.reference:
-   `= 'V'`: update the matrix Q of Schur vectors;
-   `= 'N'`: do not update Q.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix T. $N \ge 0$. If N == 0 arguments `ILST` and `IFST` may be any value.

params.name: T
params.reference: On entry, the upper quasi-triangular matrix T, in Schur Schur canonical form. On exit, the reordered upper quasi-triangular matrix, again in Schur canonical form.

params.name: ldt
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array T. $\mathrm{LDT} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: Q
params.reference: On entry, if `COMPQ = 'V'`, the matrix Q of Schur vectors. On exit, if `COMPQ = 'V'`, Q has been postmultiplied by the orthogonal transformation matrix Z which reorders T. If `COMPQ = 'N'`, Q is not referenced.

params.name: ldq
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array Q. $\mathrm{LDQ} \ge 1$, and if `COMPQ = 'V'`, $\mathrm{LDQ} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: ilst
params.reference: Specify the reordering of the diagonal blocks of T. The block with row index `IFST` is moved to row `ILST`, by a sequence of transpositions between adjacent blocks. On exit, if `IFST` pointed on entry to the second row of a 2-by-2 block, it is changed to point to the first row; `ILST` always points to the first row of the block in its final position (which may differ from its input value by +1 or -1). $1 \le \mathrm{IFST} \le N$; $1 \le \mathrm{ILST} \le N$.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
-   `= 1`: two adjacent blocks were too close to swap (the problem is very ill-conditioned); T may have been partially reordered, and `ILST` points to the first row of the current position of the block being moved.
